faqs.question: When is Tahajjud prayer prayed?
faqs.answer: Tahajjud is prayed after Isha and before Fajr. Many people pray it after sleeping and waking during the night, especially in the last part of the night.

faqs.question: Is Tahajjud obligatory?
faqs.answer: Tahajjud is a voluntary night prayer, not one of the five obligatory daily prayers.

faqs.question: How many rak'ahs are in Tahajjud?
faqs.answer: Tahajjud is commonly prayed in sets of two rak'ahs, with Witr at the end of the night prayer. The number can vary by ability, time, and local teaching.

hero.introductionHtml: Tahajjud is a voluntary night prayer prayed after Isha and before Fajr, often after waking from sleep, when the night is quiet and focused.
hero.summaryHtml:
• When: after Isha and before Fajr.
  • Best known time: the later part of the night, especially after waking.
  • Common form: prayed in pairs of two rak'ahs, then Witr.
  • Category: voluntary night prayer, not one of the five obligations.
